tasks.brief: Halo — a premium wireless home speaker from a small Copenhagen audio company. Launch page for the new model: the object, the sound technology, materials, room-filling features, specs and pre-order.

Ledgerline — a developer-first API platform for real-time payments and ledgers used by fintech engineering teams. Landing page explaining the product, the API, reliability and security, customer proof, pricing and sign-up.
Atelier Norr — a Nordic architecture studio designing timber civic buildings and homes. Portfolio site: studio philosophy, selected projects, process, awards, and contact.
Drift — an AI sleep coach app that adapts soundscapes and routines to your night. Product landing page: how it works, the science, app features, testimonials, plans and download.
